uncited: **Anchor Selection:** For each vertex, compute a curvature score using [PGK02] and a motion vector score based on correspondence matching [BLNL14].
Select the subset with the highest scores as anchors.
**Solve Linear System:** Construct $L$ and $b$ based on current $R_i$.
- **Time Complexity:** Dominated by solving the sparse linear system $L p' = b$ and computing SVDs per vertex.
It builds on the As-Rigid-As-Possible (ARAP) deformation method [SA07] by introducing a sparse set of anchors guided by curvature and motion correspondence scores [PGK02, BLNL14].
